gen-dafont-visitor-gf-mozilla-text: Mozilla Text has tall lowercase that looks bolder than it is, with terminals flaring outward past the margins of each stroke. Visitor, by contrast, is pure pixel nostalgia.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-nata-sans: Crisp, modern, a bit technical. Nata Sans keeps wide curved mouths and a steady technical-pen hand, while Visitor adds a nostalgic digital grin up top with gaping e shapes.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-nobile: Nobile reads with caps barely rising above the lowercase and open mouths like unjoined chalk arcs, a tidy, contemporary texture. Visitor looks bent from one wire.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-nokora: Approachable and nostalgic at once. Visitor draws every stroke like rod stock with gaping e mouths, while Nokora lays a dark, thick stripe of lowercase through each line.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Noto Kufi Arabic reads modern and welcoming, with a gap in the c and capitals only slightly above lowercase. Visitor is the loud one, built for pixel-era display; the body is built for the text.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans: Neutral to the core, Noto Sans fills its line height with big lowercase bodies. Visitor's nostalgic digital heading, with gaping e mouths and short ascenders, sits above, and a long passage would read steady and open.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam reads clean, with curve endings kept well apart. Visitor is pipe-straight and nostalgic, with no pinched joins, so a size slightly larger than usual would let the body's open c, s and z stand full.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-adlam-un: Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined leaves generous space between curve ends and stems, with almost no height gap between cases, under Visitor's marker-traced, nostalgic lines. A slightly larger body size would suit it.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-anatolia: Pipe-cleaner pixels on top, then outward-pointing terminals below. Visitor brings nostalgic digital grins, and Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs, with x-height near cap height, would read modern and open over a long passage.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Noto Sans Arabic reads clean and modern, with wide openings on small letters and a pronounced x-height under a pipe-bodied heading. Visitor's single quality is its nostalgic, digital stroke, and that is the pair's strongest one.
